n: <int> Number of jobs to be scheduled.
m: <int> Number of identical parallel machines available.
T: <int> Planning horizon within which all jobs must complete.

jobs.p: <int> Processing time required to complete the job.
jobs.d: <int> Due date by which the job should ideally be completed.
jobs.w: <int> Priority weight of the job, reflecting the cost per unit of tardiness.
